description: Pick a provider before writing integration code: LLM API, code sandbox, vector DB, web search, email, Postgres, auth, browser, observability. First call e.g. {task:'run untrusted Python'}. Returns the dated Depot Pick, runner-up, sourced price, when to skip it, reportOutcome, recheck. Call again with since=recheck.since before adding a provider, on pick failure or after recheck.after (unchanged = short reply). Quotes: depot.

constraints.description: Comma list, e.g. eu-region; may switch the pick

jtbd.description: Or a job id, e.g. agent-sandbox
